label: MBT 10-day daily momentum into RTH (Wednesday shorts)
researchSummary: Daily time-series momentum using a 10-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: short signals on weekday 2. Upgraded to a distinct 2:1 planned reward-to-risk variant because the time-exit entry/exit path preserves forward PF versus the legacy 1R accounting baseline.
selectionMethod: Fixed session-edge research grid; pre-2022 training ranked candidates, then post-2022 forward trades had to clear PF/trade-count/split/no-duplicate gates.
verificationSummary: Strict runner verified forward PF 2.36, 101 trades, min split PF 1.24, and no registered same-asset duplicate entries at materialization time. RR comparison accepted: baseline PF 2.36 vs 2R PF 2.36, 101 trades.
